title: Database Connection Pool Exhausted

title: API Gateway Returning 503 Errors
description: API Gateway returning 503 Service Unavailable errors. Multiple downstream services affected. Response time degraded from 200ms to 5000ms.

title: Memory Leak in Payment Service

title: Disk Space Critical on Log Server
description: Log aggregation server at 98% disk capacity. Logs from past 24 hours may be lost if not addressed immediately.

title: Authentication Service Slow Response
description: Authentication service response time increased from 50ms to 2000ms. Users experiencing delays during login. No errors in logs, but high CPU usage observed.

title: SSL Certificate Expiring in 7 Days
description: SSL certificate for api.example.com expires on 2024-02-03. Renewal process needs to be initiated.

title: Cache Invalidation Issue
description: Redis cache not invalidating properly after database updates. Users seeing stale data. Cache hit rate dropped from 95% to 60%.

title: Scheduled Job Failed - Daily Report

title: Load Balancer Health Check Failing
description: Load balancer reporting 2 out of 5 backend servers as unhealthy. Health check endpoint returning 500 errors intermittently.

title: Database Query Performance Degradation

title: Database Connection Timeout
description: Multiple reports of database connection timeouts. Similar to INC-10001. Connection pool may be exhausted.

title: API Gateway 503 Errors Continuing
description: API Gateway still returning 503 errors. Appears related to INC-10002. Multiple services impacted.

title: Payment Service OOM Error
description: Payment service crashed with OutOfMemoryError. Related to INC-10003 memory leak issue.

title: Microservice Communication Failure
description: Service-to-service communication failing. Network timeouts between order-service and inventory-service.

title: Kafka Consumer Lag Increasing
description: Kafka consumer lag increasing rapidly. Current lag: 50000 messages. Processing rate dropped significantly.

title: Elasticsearch Cluster Yellow Status
description: Elasticsearch cluster in yellow status. 3 unassigned shards. Search performance degraded.

title: CDN Cache Miss Rate High
description: CDN cache miss rate increased from 5% to 40%. Origin servers under heavy load.

title: Backup Job Failed
description: Nightly database backup job failed. Error: 'Insufficient disk space'. Last successful backup: 2 days ago.

title: Rate Limiting Triggered
description: Rate limiting triggered for multiple API endpoints. Legitimate traffic may be affected.

title: Monitoring Alert Storm
description: Alert storm detected. 500+ alerts triggered in last 10 minutes. Multiple services affected.
